title: Trophy with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M35 20 L65 20 L63 52 Q50 62 37 52 Z' fill='#FFC200' />

  <path d='M30 25 Q15 25 15 40 Q15 55 32 52' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <path d='M70 25 Q85 25 85 40 Q85 55 68 52' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='45' y='65' width='10' height='8' fill='#FFC200' rx='2'/>

  <rect x='33' y='73' width='34' height='8' fill='#FFD700' rx='3'/>

  <rect x='37' y='81' width='26' height='5' fill='#FFC200' rx='2'/>

  <path d='M43 42 Q50 49 57 42' fill='none' stroke='#8B5E00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#FFB347' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='41' r='2.5' fill='#FFB347' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Star on trophy -->
  <path d='M50 26 L51.8 30.2 L56.3 30.7 L52.9 33.8 L53.8 38.3 L50 36 L46.2 38.3 L47.1 33.8 L43.7 30.7 L48.2 30.2 Z' fill='#FF9500'/>
</svg>
